final: SELECT COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Missing') AS insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count, 1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Missing') ORDER BY insurstat
